head: be23b8f
hypothesis: Story-Yours's two passes changed how stories are spent and how much strength counts; variety_weight (0.25 today) is the untried share of the story score that sets how much the three members must differ against how well they connect. With strength at a quarter, the score leans on connection, which favours members alike in subject, so stories from one pool reuse the same subjects and pairs. A larger share for variety should pick members that differ more within each story and so spread subjects over the set: set repetition and within-story repetition fall. Unlike the assembly changes, this changes the scorer, so the rated-story AUC can see it: a share that costs AUC is a share that makes stories the owner rates lower.

head: 24695f2
hypothesis: distinct_weight (0.15 today, decision 0004) is the share of the whole story score that says no two of the three are one moment (alike by the view embedder and shot minutes apart). It was set under General before look-alikes were spent; under sy-sw25, which spends a used photo's look-alikes and leans on connection, the pairs that remain alike within a story are the ones set repetition counts twice (the same subject in two members, then again in the next story). A larger share should break those pairs and lower within-story and set repetition; a smaller one beside it reads the direction. The scorer changes, so the rated-story AUC can see it.

head: 919d69c
hypothesis: Every dial on the Strongest-Yours task moves precision by about a point (diversity, l2, quality's share, kinds): the ceiling is Yours itself, a logistic fit on CLIP ViT-B/32 vectors. CLIP is trained to match captions, so it encodes what a photo shows more than how it is made; DINOv2 (self-supervised, the view embedder) encodes composition, texture and viewpoint, and SigLIP is a stronger image-text model. Fitted on either, from the same ratings and folds, Yours should tell the owner's likes from dislikes better at places it never saw, and so raise precision. This is the first model-level mechanism the owner allowed (17 November): `[taste] embedder` in tools/harness.py (919d69c).

head: 622ff26
hypothesis: strongest-general-004 found that LAION's aesthetic score raises the owner's own precision under General (+0.057 [+0.028, +0.088] at half, +0.089 [+0.021, +0.137] alone, dev), and General with LAION alone (0.826) was above Yours (0.795) on dev. LAION was trained on many people's aesthetic ratings; Yours learns from the owner's ratings alone, on CLIP vectors, held back by l2. Given LAION's score as one more input that is not held back (fit_taste's offset, as it takes General's), Yours can lean on LAION as far as it tells the owner's likes and learn from the embedding what LAION misses, and so tell likes from dislikes better at places it never saw. Reopened for this one mechanism by the owner (17 November, evening).
